issues.title: The header's "Ask AI" button has an accessible name that does not contain its visible text
The framework switcher's tabs have accessible names that do not contain their visible text
An off-screen copy of navigation content is hidden from screen readers but still holds focusable links
Links in prose are told apart from the surrounding text by color alone
Code block line numbers fall below 4.5:1 contrast in the dark theme
Scrollable code blocks and tables cannot be scrolled from the keyboard
Embedded video and design-file frames have no title
The example grids' treegrid root holds children its role does not allow
Cell text in some examples falls below 4.5:1 contrast
Images in the custom renderer examples have no text alternative
Form fields in some examples, the grid's cell editor among them, have no label
